# propertyinsurance.law

> Property Insurance Law PLLC represents policyholders in Florida and Illinois whose property insurance claims have been denied, delayed, or underpaid. No recovery, no fee.

## Property Claims We Handle
- [Denied Claims](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/denied-homeowners-insurance-claims/): A denial letter does not necessarily mean your claim is over.
- [Delayed Claims](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/delayed-insurance-claims-florida/): If your insurance claim has been sitting for weeks or months without a clear decision, you may have options to move it forward.
- [Underpaid Claims](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/underpaid-insurance-claims/): If the insurance company’s estimate does not come close to the actual cost of repairing your property, the claim may not be finished.
- [Hurricane & Tropical Storm](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/hurricane-property-damage-lawyer/): Hurricane and tropical storm damage can affect far more than the roof, and the full extent of the loss is not always captured in the insurance company’s first inspection or estimate.
- [Wind & Hail](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/wind-and-hail-damage-insurance-claims/): Wind and hail damage is not always obvious from the ground, and disagreements over what caused the damage are common.
- [Roof Damage](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/roof-damage-insurance-claims/): Roof claims often come down to three questions: what caused the damage, how extensive it is, and whether the roof can reasonably be repaired or needs to be replaced.
- [Water Damage](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/water-damage-insurance-claims/): Water damage claims often turn on one question: was the loss sudden, or did it happen gradually over time?
- [Mold & Biohazard](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/claims/mold/): Mold and contamination claims often depend on what caused the condition, how far it spread, and which policy provisions apply to the cleanup and resulting damage.
- [Frozen & Burst Pipe](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/claims/frozen-pipe/): Frozen and burst pipe claims often turn on whether the property was properly heated and what caused the pipe to fail.
- [Fire & Smoke](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/fire-damage-insurance-claims/): Fire damage often extends far beyond the area where the flames were contained.
- [Commercial & Large Loss](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/commercial-property-insurance-claims/): Commercial property losses can affect more than the building. They can disrupt operations, reduce revenue, damage inventory and equipment, and create expenses that continue long after the initial loss.
- [Lightning](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/claims/lightning/): Lightning damage is not always obvious, and problems with electrical systems and equipment may not appear immediately after the storm.
- [Tornado](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/claims/tornado/): Tornado damage can extend well beyond what is immediately visible, and an incomplete inspection can leave major parts of the loss unpaid.
- [Theft & Vandalism](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/claims/theft/): Theft and vandalism claims can become complicated quickly, especially when the insurance company questions ownership, value, occupancy, or how the loss occurred.
- [Sinkhole & Ground Collapse](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/claims/sinkhole/): Ground movement claims can be highly technical, and coverage often depends on exactly what caused the movement and how the policy defines it.

## Other Practice Areas
- [Personal Injury](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/practice/personal-injury/): When someone else’s negligence causes a serious injury, the insurance company immediately begins evaluating what the claim is worth. You should have someone doing the same for you.
- [Slip & Fall](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/practice/slip-fall/): When a dangerous condition causes a serious injury, what happened before the fall can be just as important as what happened after it.
- [Auto Accident](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/practice/auto-accident/): After a serious crash, the insurance companies begin evaluating what happened almost immediately. You should have someone protecting your side of the case too.
- [Construction Defect](https://sha-ri.github.io/pilf-website/practice/construction-defect/): Construction defects can remain hidden for months or years before the damage becomes impossible to ignore.
